description: This file defines interfaces related to stream generators within Orleans. It includes the IStreamGenerator interface, which specifies methods for generating and reading events, and the IStreamGeneratorConfig interface for configuration purposes.

classes.name: IStreamGenerator
classes.description: Interface for stream generators used by the GeneratorStreamProvider, requiring methods to attempt reading events and configuration.

classes.name: IStreamGeneratorConfig
classes.description: Interface for generator configuration specifying the generator type.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to read events from the generator, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the stream generator with a service provider and configuration.

methods.name: StreamGeneratorType
methods.description: Property to get the type of the stream generator.
